name: Moon Environment Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Moon Environment Technology Co.,Ltd. produces and sells industrial and commercial refrigeration equipment, and refrigeration and air conditioning products in China and internationally. It provides compressor; individual, plate, and carton freezer, as well as IQF brine freezing line; heat exchanger, including evaporative condenser/cooler, air cooler, cooling tower, and plate fin heat exchanger; and ice maker, chiller, marine, food processing, freeze dryer, gas compressor, absorption unit, vessel and casting, HVAC products, innovative products, others, and spare parts.
